verdict.rationale: Green & Spiegel has a dedicated small-business and start-ups practice that offers long-term immigration policy, document maintenance and visa processing for key employees, not just founders. Its business-immigration practice describes cost-effective solutions for both the enterprise and its employees, plus employer compliance support with USCIS, DOL and ICE. This meets the story's 'stated startup/scale-up program beyond single founder cases' option. Missing for 10: explicit multi-case management or employer case-tracking tooling, details on how volume hiring is handled, and independent or hands-on corroboration from employer clients.
